title: Checkpoint: forward testing, journaling and psychology

questions.prompt: What is the main goal of forward testing on demo?

options.text: To prove the plan makes money, so you know it is safe to move to a real account
options.explanation: No: 20 demo trades is a small sample and proves nothing about future profit. No demo result shows that you are ready to trade real money.

options.text: To see if you can follow your plan live, and learn real costs and reactions
options.explanation: Right: it is about execution and learning.

questions.prompt: Which trade earns the higher process score?

options.text: Won 50 USD after moving the stop further away to give the trade room
options.explanation: No: moving the stop away is a rule break, and profit never counts.

options.text: Lost the planned 20 USD with every rule followed
options.explanation: Right: process is scored, not profit.

questions.prompt: Put the review steps in order. Which comes right after "rules followed?"

options.text: The one lesson you will carry into your next session
options.explanation: No: the result comes first, kept separate from decision quality.

options.text: Result, kept separate from decision quality
options.explanation: Right: thesis → plan vs. actual → rules followed? → result → one lesson → next goal.
No: the thesis is the first step.

questions.prompt: Planned stop 25 pips, fill 3 pips worse, pip value 2 USD. Actual risk?

options.explanation: No: that is the planned risk.
No: a worse fill adds pips, it does not remove them.

questions.prompt: After three losses, you feel the urge to win it back. Which response fits a good plan?

options.explanation: No: that is revenge trading and sizing up after losses.

options.text: Stop or pause as your plan says, and note the feeling
options.explanation: Right: the plan is there for this moment.

questions.prompt: Why are imported MT demo trades kept separate from replay and paper trades?

options.text: So different sources never mix in your results
options.explanation: Right: each source has different conditions.

options.text: Because imported trades do not count toward your progress at all
options.explanation: No: they count, they are just labelled by source.
